div.div:
Key idea: actions are tokens
- π₀-FAST emits its whole action chunk as a token sequence (FAST tokenizer)
- RL treats it like a language model: sample tokens, replay them with teacher forcing
- One trajectory-level GRPO advantage per trajectory, PPO clipping per token
- Malformed sequences are not resampled: zero action + normal failure reward (on-policy)
